{{Top}}
[[File:Imperial_Ensign.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial ensign.]]
{{Quote|More power, Ensign! You've got to give me more receiving power!|Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref>}}
'''Ensign''' was the lowest rating of [[Officer/Legends|officer]] within most [[Navy/Legends|space navies]], being bestowed upon a being immediately after graduating from a service [[academy]].

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

This rank was the lowest officer line rank used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and ranked below [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]]. Ensigns held a position of [[Midshipman/Legends|midshipmen]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] Officer, [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight Officer]], and [[Engineering Division]] [[Engineering officer/Legends|Officer]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Ensigns typically were given supervisory positions over enlisted crew, however they were too junior to actually have a command billet. Ensigns also could not take command of any situation, unless in the absence of a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] or other superior officer. Persons of this rank were typically assigned as watch officers, military aides, [[Envoy/Legends|envoys]] or even bodyguards for various higher-ranking officers such as [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]]. Ensigns also sometimes led ground missions, leading a vessel's complement of troopers on whatever task needed doing.

During off-duty hours, or when in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], an ensign could be given command of a [[Warship/Legends|warship]], primarily to test their abilities, but also to give the regular officers some time off. When the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] or another higher-ranking officer judged them ready, the ensign would be promoted the next appropriate grade, and continue on their career path.

A Republic ensign tried to kill [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] with a vibroblade after losing to him at a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], but he was killed when Dessel shoved the blade back at him.
